utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy we’re moving on this, but before we tell everyone, can we confirm the pharmacy lot permission and figure out where cars will queue so we don’t block the street?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, that sounds wise—let’s hold off on a wider notice until the pharmacy confirms. I can ask quietly about permission and sketch a simple queue plan so we keep the street clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Rey—that would ease my mind a lot. If you can get the permission in writing and mark where drop-offs should line up, I’ll feel better about letting Quinn spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn, I’m still waiting on firm commitments for the repair drive, so I don’t want to promise anything yet. If you hear directly who’s bringing tools, tell me and I’ll pass along the confirmed list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Tess—I won’t promise anything until I hear directly from folks. I’ll keep my running list to confirmed tools and items only, and I’ll send you updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Quinn, thank you—confirmed only is exactly what we need. Send me whatever you get, and I’ll make sure everyone hears the reliable list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Jules, I’m still piecing it together, but Rosa said they’re gathering repair requests this week so the first fixes can start Saturday—do you have anything that needs a look?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell—I don’t have a repair item myself, but I can help spread the word and steer folks toward Rosa with requests before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s perfect, thanks Jules—if you hear of anyone with a small fix, just point them toward Rosa this week so she can match supplies and volunteers before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I’m trying to help spread the word on the repair drive, but Noah said folks are still sorting out what needs fixing first—do you know who’s coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s mostly me in the loosest possible sense, though Cleo’s keeping the list tidy while I confirm needs today. Tell Vik—I mean, tell folks—to send repair notes my way, and I’ll loop Noah in once I’m caught up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Dane—I’ll tell folks to send repair notes your way, and I’ll let Noah know you’ll loop him in once the needs are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, I can share the confirmed drop-off details, but I’m still checking the urgent repair list and volunteer gaps before I say what help we need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Hana—send me the confirmed drop-off bit when you have it, and I’ll hold off on telling folks what help is most needed until you’ve checked the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — the confirmed drop-off is Saturday morning in the community room for small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending items, with each item labeled and any loose parts included.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! For the repair drive, we’re collecting small fixable items this week, and if you know anyone who can volunteer Saturday, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa—before I spread the word, can you confirm whether the pharmacy lot is definitely approved in writing, and who’s confirmed for supplies or Saturday help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—the pharmacy lot approval came through in writing this morning, so we’re set there. For supplies, I have basic tools and labels covered, but I’m still confirming extension cords and Saturday repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, let’s keep it straightforward: drop-off at my garage Saturday from 9 to noon, and I’ll post a clear bring-list so folks know what to label and bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli—I’ll be there a little before 9 to help set up, sort tools, and check folks in at the table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Sam, I appreciate that. If you can handle check-in at the folding table, I’ll keep the drop-off line moving and make sure each item has a note on what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina, I’ve got the 10 to noon intake slot covered after drop-off, and I’m asking parents at pickup who can bring basics like screwdrivers and pliers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye—that helps. Can you note exactly which parents can bring which tools, and flag anyone who can stay past noon if intake runs long?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’ll make a quick list at pickup with names, tools, and whether they can linger past noon if we get backed up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello Opal — I think Eli settled on Saturday, 9 to noon, for the repair drive, with folks bringing small appliances and a little note about what’s broken. I might be missing a detail, but that’s the plan I remember.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Oren — I have Saturday 9 to noon at Eli’s garage for drop-off, and I’ll add that folks should bring small appliances with a note about what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Opal, I may be muddled, but I thought the drop-off was the community room, not Eli’s garage—maybe best to double-check with Eli before you post it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I’m catching updates while I’m out—do you know the confirmed start time for Saturday’s repair drive, and whether they still need folks for rails, steps, or wiring cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t know the confirmed start time yet, sorry—I’m a bit behind on the latest. Last I knew they were still sorting priorities, but I’ll check with the coordinator about rails, steps, and wiring cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—I’ll swing by the community room too and see if they’ve posted the time, then I’ll pass the confirmed details along to Leo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Mara, I’m still cross-checking the repair drive list, but the current needs look like basic tools, extension cords, spare fasteners, work gloves, and labeled sorting bins.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that list sounds right, and the labeled sorting bins will really help keep Saturday morning from getting chaotic. Let’s add those needs to the volunteer note so folks can bring what they have.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll add those confirmed needs to the volunteer note and mark batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies as still waiting on confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’m already bringing my toolbox, cordless drill, pliers, and a couple extension cords Saturday morning—happy to lend a hand wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus—that’s perfect. If you’re comfortable, I’ll put you with the safety repairs crew for rails, steps, and small wiring cleanup once Ira confirms the exact start time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo—put me down for the safety repairs crew, and just let me know when Ira confirms the start time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I heard the repair drive’s still sorting out what needs fixing first—do you know who’s coordinating it so I can pass the right word around?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s me, Vik—I’m coordinating the repair drive and gathering repair requests this week. If folks have small appliances or tools needing minor fixes, send them my way with a note about what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll tell folks you’re collecting requests this week for small appliances and tools with a note on the issue.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Pia. For the repair drive, we’ll use my garage Saturday from 9 to noon, and I’m putting a clear bring-list on the bulletin board today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli—that helps, but can we also mark where people should park and set a drop-off spot that won’t block your driveway or the street?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good point, Pia. I’ll mark parking along the school-side curb and set the drop-off table just inside my garage so nobody blocks the driveway or street.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Nell. If you still need hands for the repair drive, I can come by and help quietly wherever I’m useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli—that sounds really helpful. From what I’ve heard, Rosa’s matching volunteers with supplies, so I can point you her way or pass along that you’re available for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. If you could let Rosa know I’m available Saturday, I’d appreciate it—I’ll take whatever small job needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Kira—if I’ve got it right, the repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon in the community room, and folks should bring small appliances or lamps with a note about what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds plausible, Oren, but can you confirm who told you those details? I don’t want us repeating the time or item list unless it’s actually settled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You’re right to check, Kira—Eli suggested Saturday 9 to noon and said he’d write up the bring-list, so I’d treat it as settled by him, though I can double-check the bulletin board before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, we’re prioritizing safety repairs first—rails, steps, and wiring issues. I’m waiting on Ira to confirm Saturday’s start time, but can you help with carpentry or electrical cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with carpentry cleanup and sorting parts, but I’ll leave wiring to someone more experienced. I’m also gathering tools, cords, gloves, and checking on batteries or patch kits.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’s perfect, Rey—stick with carpentry cleanup and parts sorting, and bring whatever tools and gloves you can. I’ll update you once Ira confirms the Saturday start time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I’m checking in on the repair drive—Mara and I are trying to give everyone clear roles, and Faye can help with intake from 10 to noon plus maybe 3 to 4. Would you be comfortable taking a repair table role or helping with pickup?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with pickup while I’m already out, and I’ll confirm the Saturday start time when I swing by the community room. If they’re short at the tables, I can probably cover a repair table for a bit too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Ira—thank you. I’ll pencil you in for pickup help and keep you as a possible repair-table backup once you confirm the Saturday start time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I’m already bringing my drill, pliers, toolbox, and extension cords Saturday morning—anything else you want me to toss in for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Gus—thank you. If you’ve got spare tape, zip ties, a work light, or a power strip, those would be helpful too, and please label your tools so they make it back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mara—I’ll add tape, zip ties, a work light, and a power strip, and I’ll label everything before I bring it Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Mina — I’m still cross-checking the supply list, but confirmed needs so far seem to be basic tools, extension cords, spare fasteners, work gloves, and labeled bins.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo—can you confirm quantities for each, and flag anything we need before Saturday morning setup?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have firm quantities yet, Mina, but I’ll check with the folks coordinating stations and flag anything truly needed before Saturday morning setup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess, I’m updating the repair drive list: I have Eli’s garage for Saturday 9 to noon, and the community center lobby still needs Mira’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Opal—that’s the firmest bit I’ve heard yet, so I’ll pass along Eli’s garage for Saturday 9 to noon and mark the lobby as pending until Mira confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Tess—please label Eli’s garage as confirmed, and I’ll hold off on the community center lobby until I hear from Mira.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think they were still sorting out what needs fixing first, but I may have missed the latest, so I’ll check who’s coordinating it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah—if you find out who’s coordinating, send them my way and I’ll fold their list into the tools/items signup so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that makes sense—I’ll ask around and point the coordinator to you once I figure out who it is.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Faye, I told Leo I can help sort tools and check folks in at the repair drive—anything you’d like me to coordinate with you too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam—that’d be a big help. I’m doing intake from 10 to noon after drop-off, so if you can help sort tools then, I’ll also ask parents at pickup who’s bringing screwdrivers and pliers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye—I’ll be there from 10 to noon to sort tools, and I’ll check in with you about the screwdriver and plier count after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but I’m checking today whether tarps, basic tools, and cleaning supplies are the biggest needs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I know the confirmed drop-off details, but I don’t want to guess on supplies yet. Let’s check Mara’s urgent list first, then I can help tell folks what’s actually still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds right, Hana — I’ll check Mara’s urgent list before I confirm anything to Cleo. Once we’ve got that, I’ll help point folks to the real gaps instead of my late guesses.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
